module: Node "Get Map Objects IDs by DynField" (repeat_instant). Returns the list of ids of the map objects (map.objects, hence the tracked vehicles) that have a given dynamic field. Input: dynamicFieldName. Output: objects (table of ids).
notes: Only the field name is tested, not its value.
Recomputed every frame: cost proportional to the number of objects.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

_executionStarted.desc: Sets oldPos to nil (field unused afterwards).

findObjectsWithDynField.desc: Iterates over map.objects, reads object:getDynamicFields() and returns the ids for which a name matches.

dynamicFieldName.desc: Name of the dynamic field searched.

work.desc: If the name is provided, recomputes the list every frame and writes it to objects.
